record.what_it_does: Team chat and collaboration platform from Zoho with channels, bots, and extensions.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 only. Register a client in the Zoho API console, get a grant code, exchange it for access and refresh tokens, and send "Zoho-oauthtoken {token}" as a header. Scopes look like ZohoCliq.Messages.READ. You must use the right data-center domain (.com, .eu, .in and so on). Access tokens last about 1 hour. Some APIs, such as maintenance and roles, are admin-only.
record.access_notes: A free Cliq plan exists, and the Zoho API console is self-serve. I did not see any API plan gating or app-review gate in the docs. Distribution of a multi-data-center OAuth client may need extra setup, but I could not confirm that. Admin-only APIs need an org admin.
record.api_breadth_notes: REST v2 at cliq.zoho.com/api/v2. It covers Users, Departments, Roles, Chats, Channels, Threads, Teams, Messages, Scheduled Messages, Bots, Files, Calls, Events, Reminders, Cliq Database, and bulk-export maintenance APIs. Per-endpoint rate limits apply, and exceeding them returns HTTP 429.
record.mcp_notes: Zoho runs an official Cliq MCP server, set up through the Zoho MCP console, which gives you an MCP URL. Docs are at zoho.com/cliq/help/platform/zoho-cliq-mcp.html and zoho.com/cliq/help/platform/configure-zoho-cliq-mcp.html. Zoho also publishes guides for connecting it to Claude, Cursor, and VS Code.
record.blocker_notes: The API is broad and OAuth2 is self-serve. Watch for the per-data-center domains, the per-endpoint rate limits, and the admin-only APIs.

evidence.quote: All API requests must be made over HTTPS.
Free Chat plans for all Teams size
brings your chats into the world of AI using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

record.needs_human: The REST docs page was truncated, so I only read the first part. Please confirm three things. First, whether the REST API has outbound webhooks, since Cliq bots and incoming-webhook handlers exist but I did not see them in the docs. Second, whether a sandbox exists. Third, whether any scope review or plan gating applies to public OAuth apps. I also could not confirm the MCP auth model or plan requirements.
